_comment: FIX118/FIX119 — how a turn ended, one closed set for chat-edge (Go), the desktop host (TS), the web page (TS) and the backend (Python). Each tree has a test that reads this file; change it here first. `transport_codes` says which catalogue error code a client mints when the failure has no gateway code of its own (backend/app/core/error_catalog.py is the catalogue; GENERATION_INTERRUPTED is chat-edge's own resume code, known to the web dictionary). `stop_reasons` (FIX119) is WHY THE MODEL STOPPED, distinct from terminal_cause (why the run ended): a run that completed can still carry stop_reason max_tokens. `stop_reason_map` is the one table that turns each provider family's native value into the closed set; a value missing from its family's table maps to `unknown` and is logged with the provider and the raw value. A missing value is `unknown`, never end_turn.

cause_meaning.completed: the run produced its answer and said so (message_complete / [DONE] / a finish reason)
cause_meaning.error: a terminal error frame named the failure; error_code says which
cause_meaning.timeout: nobody spoke for too long: an idle watchdog or a deadline ended the run while the connection was still up
cause_meaning.disconnected: the connection to the provider BROKE while the run was live: a reset, a torn body, an unexpected EOF, a transport throw. The process that owned the run was alive and saw the break happen.
cause_meaning.eof_without_terminal: the connection to the provider closed CLEANLY while the run was live, but nothing said the answer was done: no [DONE], no error frame, no finish reason. The process that owned the run was alive and saw the clean close.
cause_meaning.interrupted: the PROCESS that owned the run died (chat-edge restart, the desktop app closed) before any ending was seen. Nobody was there to observe how the connection ended; the ending is written later, by a resume, a ledger replay or an orphan sweep, and always after the fact.

stop_reason_meaning.end_turn: the model finished its answer on its own
stop_reason_meaning.max_tokens: the model hit the output-token limit; the answer is cut off and can be continued
stop_reason_meaning.tool_use: the model stopped to call a tool; the run continues with the tool result
stop_reason_meaning.stop_sequence: a caller-supplied stop sequence ended the answer
stop_reason_meaning.content_filter: the provider's content filter ended the answer
stop_reason_meaning.refusal: the model declined to answer; this is not a system failure
stop_reason_meaning.context_window_exceeded: the provider stopped because the context window was exceeded during generation
stop_reason_meaning.unknown: the provider sent no stop reason, or one no table names

stop_reason_wire.gateway_final_chunk: choices[0].stop_reason beside the OpenAI-shaped finish_reason; provider_request_id at the chunk top level when the provider returned one
stop_reason_wire.row: chat.messages_masked.stop_reason (migration 044); NULL for user rows, pre-044 rows and failed runs
